title: Understanding the Loss Function
text: The loss function Shreya uses is $$L(hat_y,y)=hat_y-\theta_2 y$$. Think about how this function measures the difference between the predicted value $$hat_y$$ and the actual value $$y$$, scaled by $$\theta_2$$.

title: Gradient Descent Basics
text: In stochastic gradient descent, we update the parameters by moving in the direction that reduces the loss. This involves computing the gradient of the loss with respect to each parameter.

title: Compute the Gradient for $$\theta_1$$
text: To find the gradient of the loss with respect to $$\theta_1$$, differentiate the loss function $$L(hat_y,y)=hat_y-\theta_2 y$$ with respect to $$\theta_1$$. Remember that $$hat_y=\theta_2 \theta_1 x$$.

title: Gradient Calculation for $$\theta_1$$
text: What is the gradient of the loss function with respect to $$\theta_1$$?

title: Update Rule for $$\theta_1$$
text: Once you have the gradient, use the update rule: $${\theta_1}^{t+1}={\theta_1}^t-\alpha gradient$$. Substitute the values you have to find the new $$\theta_1$$.

title: Calculate $${\theta_1}^{t+1}$$
text: Using the update rule and the gradient you found, what is the new value of $$\theta_1$$?
